نرتخي (form VIII)
# نَرْتَخِي (nartaḵī) /nar.ta.xiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَخَى (irtaḵā)
# نَرْتَخِيَ (nartaḵiya) /nar.ta.xi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَخَى (irtaḵā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
